ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the direct proportion function $y=ax$ and the graph of the linear function $y=kx+2$ intersect at the point $(2, 1)$, what is the solution set of the inequality $kx+2\ge ax$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} The intersection point of the two lines is at $(2,1)$,\\
when $x=2$, the values of the two functions are equal,\\
when $x<2$, the line $y=kx+2$ is above the line $y=ax$, thus $kx+2>ax$,\\
therefore, the solution set for the inequality $kx+2\ge ax$ is: $\boxed{x\leq 2}$.
